accepts: V3B_FULL_BOQ_RECOMMENDATION.md (1d70f7f) with the decisions and mandatory corrections below

decisions.decision: plain unreinforced layer poured directly over the prepared / compacted soil at the applicable foundation / formation level, over every independently founded footprint (annex included where it has its own founded footprint); footings are set out and built above it
rules: project source overrides when the drawings clearly show another level or isolated-only blinding
thickness: SOURCE > PROJECT OWNER FACT > URBAN METHOD (typically 0.10 m; 0.10-0.15 common) > PENDING; Alsenan 0.10 m from the p.13 detail
NOT 'full footprint at ground-beam bottom + footing steps' unless the source positively shows it

double-count guard: the local 10 cm footing / beam blinding in the typical detail is the same physical layer when it is a sectional representation of the full working slab; a separate pad / step only where geometry proves another layer or level
publish SOURCE_DETAIL_LOCAL_BLINDING and OWNER_FULL_FOOTPRINT_BLINDING side by side: area, thickness, volume, level, source, cross-check method (Route B against the footprint geometry)

decisions.decision: plain f'c >= 150 kg/cm2 (note 6); reinforced f'c >= 300 kg/cm2 (note 6); soil / groundwater contact: sulfate- and salt-resisting cement (note 13)
rules: never a generic 350 kg/cm2
record CONCRETE_STRENGTH, CEMENT_TYPE, SOIL_CONTACT, SULFATE_REQUIREMENT, SOURCE separately
K150-K200 blinding practice is background only; the printed 150 kg/cm2 governs Alsenan blinding

decisions.decision: wall tile, plaster and paint are paid NET: gross eligible face - full openings + applicable reveals
rules: gross stays TRACE / alternative only, never the payable quantity

decisions.decision: faces receiving ceramic / porcelain (bath, WC, shower, kitchen, pantry / prep, laundry / washing, ironing and any tiled face): SPATTER DASH -> TILE PREPARATION -> TILE; no rough + smooth plaster beneath unless the project requires it
rules: items TILE_PREP / SPATTER_DASH m2 and WALL_TILE_NET m2 kept separate
no general plaster on a tiled face

decisions.decision: SPATTER DASH -> ROUGH PLASTER (مساح خشن) -> SMOOTH PLASTER (مساح ناعم) -> PAINT / final finish
rules: SPATTER_DASH_INTERNAL, ROUGH_PLASTER_INTERNAL, SMOOTH_PLASTER_INTERNAL, PAINT_INTERNAL_NET are separate items on the same geometric population

decisions.decision: SPATTER DASH -> CLADDING SYSTEM; no rough + smooth plaster behind unless the project detail requires it
rules: EXTERNAL_SPATTER_DASH m2 and STONE / MARBLE CLADDING m2 separate

decisions.decision: SPATTER DASH -> ROUGH PLASTER -> SMOOTH PLASTER -> SIGMA
rules: each facade classified by its final finish
stone and Sigma preparations are never assumed equal

decisions.decision: steel angle / corner beads measured as a separate lm item at exposed plaster edges: door / opening jambs, window edges (incl. below / around where the site method requires), external plastered corners and exposed corners receiving a bead
rules: never on a hidden or non-plastered edge
never on a fully tiled edge unless the project specifies it
segment record: HOST WALL / OPENING, EDGE TYPE, LENGTH, SOURCE, FINISH POPULATION, STATUS
V3a 15.7 lm superseded by the geometry engine

decisions.decision: measure reveals: opening deduction + eligible reveal addition; source depth where known else the controlled Urban reveal fallback, labelled
rules: DOOR_REVEALS and WINDOW_REVEALS visible items / components

decisions.decision: cornice only where a drawing, ceiling layout, specification or owner / project fact establishes it; geometry known but presence unknown = PENDING / REVIEW, never zero

labelled PROVISIONAL quantities may enter the COMMERCIAL total; procurement eligibility: MEASURED, DERIVED, RECONCILED, SOURCE_RULE, CODE_METHOD, OWNER_APPROVED_PROVISIONAL, HIGH-CONFIDENCE SOURCE PROVISIONAL (labelled) = yes; LOW-CONFIDENCE BUDGET_ESTIMATE, TRUE BLOCKER = no
rules: every provisional shows CLASS, METHOD, ASSUMPTION, CONFIDENCE, LOW RANGE, HIGH RANGE, PROCUREMENT_ELIGIBLE

decisions.decision: every applicable row / room carries NET, WASTE METHOD, WASTE %, WASTE QTY, PROCUREMENT; no universal % exists: unapproved = PENDING with blank % / qty / procurement, never 0
rules: hierarchy ITEM OVERRIDE > TRADE / MATERIAL RULE > PROJECT RULE > PENDING

rebar: deterministic cutting optimisation, 12.00 m stock unless supplier / project states otherwise; output net, lap, hook / bend, purchased, reused offcut, unused offcut, effective waste %, procurement (t)
concrete: net volume stays the BOQ; POUR / ORDER ALLOWANCE separate and PENDING

decisions.decision: project drawing / detail > project notes / specification > applicable Kuwait RC code / authority > referenced ACI requirements > recognised detailing / fabrication standard > provisional code method > owner input > BLOCKED
rules: Alsenan laps 70Ø tension / 40Ø compression (source) are never replaced by generic splice values
hooks / bends / stirrup closing promoted to technical CODE_METHOD only when the governing basis / edition is verified; otherwise PROVISIONAL_CODE_METHOD with the exact code / table recorded
no internet BBS constants

corrections.rule: the +1.00 level chain alone does not prove depth; technical DERIVED only when beam top AND bottom are established from section / detail / binding; otherwise PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_DERIVED with the depth assumption explicit

note 18 (slab 16 cm unless stated) is not proof of the waist; search stair section / detail / reinforcement / thickness notation first; otherwise 16 cm is PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_DERIVED / CODE_METHOD candidate, never SOURCE_RULE; risers can still be technical if the section proves them

publish F_SCENARIO, F10_SCENARIO, LOW, HIGH, DIFFERENCE; technical BLOCKED_SOURCE_CONFLICT; commercial PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_RANGE; a selected conservative scenario enters the commercial total only explicitly labelled as the selected commercial basis

DXF topology vs DXF DIMENSION reconstruction is calculation-independent, not source-independent; add a cross-source Route C (arch PDF area sheet, PDF elevation / section, CAD oracle) where possible; report CALCULATION_INDEPENDENCE and SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE separately

rebar: ITEM, BAR_SET, POPULATION and WEIGHT_COVERAGE_ESTIMATE %; concrete: ITEM, ELEMENT_OCCURRENCE and EXPECTED_VOLUME_SCOPE % where a defensible denominator exists; item count alone never describes a trade

standing: benchmark sealed until the Urban freeze
